business_summary: Datang Environment Industry Group Co., Ltd. provides environmental protection and energy conservation solutions to coal-fired power generation enterprises in the People's Republic of China. It operates through the following segments: Environmental Protection and Energy Conservation Solutions, Renewable Energy Engineering, Thermal Power Engineering, and Other Businesses. The Environmental Protection and Energy Conservation Solutions segment engages in the flue gas desulfurization and denitrification facilities concession operation business for coal-fired power plants; and provides engineering services for coal-fired power plants, including denitrification, desulfurization, dust removal, ash and slag handling, other environmental protection facilities, and industrial site dust management solutions. It also offers water treatment and energy conservation services, such as energy conservation facility engineering and energy management contracting. The Renewable Energy Engineering segment provides engineering general contracting services for newly built wind power plants, biomass power plants, and photovoltaic power plants. The Thermal Power Engineering segment offers engineering, procurement, and construction services for thermal power plants. The Other Businesses engages in the fiberglass chimney anti-corrosion and air-cooling system engineering general contracting business. In addition, the company involved in the development of pollution improvement environmental protection technology and the provision of testing, project management, and engineering and technology services. Datang Environment Industry Group Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2011 and is headquartered in Beijing, the People's Republic of China. Datang Environment Industry Group Co., Ltd. is a subsidiary of China Datang Corporation Ltd.
business_summary_ko: Datang Environment Industry Group Co., Ltd.는 중화인민공화국의 석탄 화력 발전 기업에 환경 보호 및 에너지 절약 솔루션을 제공합니다. 환경 보호 및 에너지 보존 솔루션, 재생 에너지 엔지니어링, 화력 엔지니어링 및 기타 사업 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 환경 보호 및 에너지 보존 솔루션 부문은 석탄 화력 발전소의 배연 탈황 및 탈질 시설 임대 운영 사업에 종사합니다. 탈질, 탈황, 먼지 제거, 회분 및 슬래그 처리, 기타 환경 보호 시설, 산업 현장 먼지 관리 솔루션 등 석탄 화력 발전소에 대한 엔지니어링 서비스를 제공합니다. 또한, 에너지 절약 시설 엔지니어링, 에너지 관리 계약 등 수처리 및 에너지 절약 서비스도 제공하고 있습니다. 재생에너지 엔지니어링 부문은 새로 건설된 풍력 발전소, 바이오매스 발전소, 태양광 발전소에 대한 엔지니어링 일반 계약 서비스를 제공합니다. 화력 엔지니어링 부문은 엔지니어링, 조달을 제공합니다.
